title: Notes Java Conditional Control Constructs Conclusion

items.question: Write a Java program that reads an integer from the user and checks whether the number is even using a method named checkEven().
Write a Java program that reads the age of a person and checks whether the person is eligible for voting using if-else.
Write a Java program that reads student marks and checks whether the student passed or failed using if-else.
Write a Java program that reads student marks and displays the grade using an if-else ladder.
Write a Java program that reads the age of a person and displays the ticket category using an if-else ladder.
Write a Java program that reads a number from the user and prints the corresponding day name using a switch statement.
Write a Java program that reads two integers and an operator from the user and performs the calculation using a switch statement.
Write a Java program that reads a temperature in degrees Celsius and classifies it into one of four categories.
Write a Java program that reads an integer and determines whether it is divisible by 3, divisible by 5, divisible by both 3 and 5, or divisible by neither.
Write a Java program that reads the cost price and selling price of an item and determines whether the transaction results in a profit, a loss, or neither.
Write a Java program that reads the total number of classes held and the number of classes attended by a student. Calculate the student’s attendance percentage using the following formula:
Write a Java program that reads a conversion choice and a value. Use a switch statement to perform the selected unit conversion.
